(1) 2745:3566 Frame 199, the MIC, is hidden and sits at (0,0) of a right group that is only 32 wide, with 2745:3568 Frame 198, the send, at the SAME (0,0). The two are stacked layers, so the visible board holds exactly ONE control on the right - which is what the frame's name means and why a disabled-but-present mic would be wrong: that group would measure 71 (32+7+32) and push send off x=608. (2) 2745:3558 cost at (44,9) 223x14 is hidden and carries Estimated: 0.30 SKAI and Balance: 1,187 SKAI. VERDICT MATCH, AND THE SHIPPED CODE WAS ALREADY RIGHT - nothing was changed to reach it. 2005-9301.notes: PRIMITIVE REPAIR ON AN UNMOUNTED COMPONENT - READ THIS BEFORE READING THE NUMBERS. The frame itself is NOT served by the file in column 3: 2005-9301 was closed `done` by supersession in wave 58 under Casey's 2026-09-19 ruling that the August set governs, and auth-modal.tsx is what serves it. The status here is `done` only so this row cannot regress that verdict; nothing on this row claims a new frame closure. What landed is a repair to the MAY-era twin that still draws this board and is mounted NOWHERE. THE MOUNT QUESTION, ANSWERED FOUR WAYS, because the hand-off's claim was a lead and not a fact. (1) A repo-wide sweep of every .ts/.tsx finds exactly two importers of WaitlistModal: its own test, and the barrel at overlays/index.ts:18 which re-exports it. No app or landing file imports it. A second, independent sweep widened to .js and .json agreed: outside skai-ui itself the only main-tree hits are a STALE BUILT BUNDLE (dist-explorer-public/assets/vendor-skai-ui-BOqh3CiP.js, a compiled copy, not a caller), a coverage artefact, the vestigial setShowWaitlistModal state calls, and a data-testid on a test stub - no import and no JSX element anywhere. (2) skai-landing's `showWaitlistModal` is a VESTIGIAL STATE NAME and not a mount - LandingWaitlist.tsx:64 imports AuthModal, and the state drives `<AuthModal>` at LandingWaitlist.tsx:2686, under a comment that names the two ALT frames on the rows below. M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:10407-13075.title: Load screen - refresh screen - mobile
M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:10407-13075.screen: Casino > Starbound - Load screen - refresh screen - mobile
M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:10407-13075.notes: RE-EXAMINED AT HEAD THIS PASS RATHER THAN CARRIED, because three waves have recorded this as unbuildable and a reason not to act is the note least often re-read. The composition is not in doubt and is unchanged: Overlay at .34 with no blur; a 112x288 streak centred with its bottom 140 below the panel (10407:14054); the astronaut 176x210 upright centred at (50%+0.5, 50%+92); the logo 128x61 at (50%+0.5, 50%-161.5); no grid, no bar, no text. WHAT IS NEW: the engine DOES have a state whose shape matches, and it was missed because it is a consequence of two files rather than a named scene. BootScene.relayout() (BootScene.ts) is this.scene.restart(), which re-runs preload on the SAME Phaser game; preloads queue() skips every texture where this.textures.exists(texture); so a relayout queues NOTHING, and Phaser fires no progress at all on an empty queue (LoaderPlugin.start calls loadComplete() directly for list.size === 0, phaser 3.90.0). A re-boot with nothing to load is exactly a load screen with no progress to show - which is what this frame draws: the load screen MINUS the bar and the caption. THAT IS A CANDIDATE, NOT A RULING, AND NOTHING WAS BUILT ON IT. The frame still carries no annotation of what raises it, and a relayout is not obviously what a designer means by refresh. DECISION FOR CASEY, as a choice: (a) this is the re-boot state - the boot screen drawn without bar or caption whenever the queue is empty, which the engine can detect today at no cost; (b) it is a browser page refresh or reconnect, which needs a session-restore state the engine does not have; (c) it is decoration with no trigger and the frame is ruled out. Separately and INDEPENDENT of the ruling, this pass fixed a real defect on the path (skai-gaming e601eb75): that same empty queue left this.progress on its initial 0, so every relayout held an EMPTY groove captioned Loading... 0% for the 320ms hold in create, under a comment promising a full bar. Whoever builds this frame draws the streak from the cosmic skins own STREAKS record (09e37a78 took engine-constant streaks off all five games). M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:10688-7224.title: Rectangle 34624567
M6r9FEn042UWTQD1zvy6GM:10688-7224.notes: CLOSED AT ALL THREE WIDTHS (skai-gaming c2f1c8c8), on the one item wave 61 measured and handed off. 375 closed in 8bc8eb56 and the two wide cuts were built in bd845403; what kept both partial was that PlayGameTitleRow drew its 32x32 art square with object-cover. Cover picks the right SIZE - a 1200x1700 fill scaled by 32/1200 is 32x45.3333, which IS the boards own 100% by 141.67% - and then CENTRES it at top (32-45.3333)/2 = -6.6667px = -20.833%, where all three board instances read -2.99% = -0.9568px. That is a 5.71px vertical crop on a 32px square: the boards deliberately show more of the gamblers hat and the app cut it off at 768 and 1440 while the phone row drew it correctly. THE FIX IS THE PEERS AND IS CITED, NOT CLAIMED: play-hub landed skai-gaming 933ed7ab, which gives PlayGameTitleRowProps an optional artBox of four percentages (PlayGameTitleArtBox, exported from PlayGamePageShell.tsx:87, structurally identical to SlotHeaderArt[box]); their file was never edited here. This commit is the two lines that use it - artBox={VEGAS_HEADER_ART.box} on the md-up row, so the wide rows and the phone row now draw one picture at one crop. ONE THING THIS LANE HAD WRONG AND THE PEER CAUGHT, recorded because it would have shipped a fresh 2.8px error: an absolutely positioned child resolves percentages against the PADDING box, which the squares 1px stroke leaves at 30x30, while the boards numbers are percentages of its own 32. The component pulls the image into an inset-[-1px] layer so 141.67% draws 45.333 and not 42.5; a page must not wrap the img itself. Tests: VegasFortunePage.test.tsx asserts the MOUNT on the route - the four percentages on the wide img, that it carries no object-cover, and that its top and height equal the phone rows - and the square assertion moved from a parent walk to closest(.size-8) so it holds whether or not a box is passed. MUTATION-TESTED: dropping artBox from the call site turns the crop test red and leaves the square test green, which is the separation intended. Scoped tsc over six files, all six proved in the program with --listFiles: 0 errors in this lanes files. STILL OPEN AND NOT CLOSED BY THIS ROW, recorded rather than asserted: the square draws a 1px border-green-coal-100 (#123F3C) and neither Vegas board INSTANCE carries a border at all, while the game-page boards the row was originally measured against (baccarat 9799:16719, keno 9433:12193, blackjack 9003:119191) all do and playGameTitleRowResolved.test.tsx pins it at three widths. Removing it would regress ten pages to close none; it needs the slot page MASTERS re-read, which nobody has done since wave 60. Committed, not pushed, not deployed (Ruling 16); no browser measured it.
